tool_input.description: Patch scene builder for anchored effects
Rewrite content components with new styling
Build and screenshot the art review page

tool_input.command: S="home introduction installation quick-start configuration caching running-in-ci cli-commands task-api plugin-api troubleshooting faq migrating-from-v2 changelog search-empty not-found"; SEL=""; for s in $S; do for k in lead gaps verticals details ridges path; do SEL="$SEL .s-$s-$k"; done; done; node pigment-snap.mjs --measure /__art $SEL 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\s*$' | sed -E 's/^  \{"text":"([^"]*)".*/\1/' | grep -v "no match" | awk '/^\.s-/{printf "\n%s ", $1; next}{printf "%s", $0}'
tool_input.description: Print computed numbers for every scene

tool_input.command: node pigment-snap.mjs --measure /__art .q0le .q0ga .q0ve .q0de .q0ri .q0pa .q1le .q1ga .q1ve .q1de .q1ri .q2le .q2ga .q2ve .q2de .q3le .q3ga .q3ve .q3de .q4le .q4ga .q4ve .q4de .q5le .q5ga .q5ve .q5de .q6le .q6ga .q6ve .q6de .q7le .q7ga .q7ve .q7de 2>/dev/null | grep -o '^\.q[^:]*:\|"text":"[^"]*"' | sed 's/"text":"//; s/"$//' | tr '\n' '|' | sed 's/|\.q/\n.q/g; s/|//g'
